Round 10 fails: the video-after-loop bug (C-R7-01) is still open, while the ruler fix (C-R7-02) passes and closes. I made no app changes. The working tree is the same at the start and end of my session, and the browser daemon is stopped.

| ID | Result |
|---|---|
| **R10-W1** (video lands correctly after a loop wrap) | **FAIL** |
| R10-W2 (A's diagnosis data) | PASS |
| R10-W3 (unit test for a fix) | Not applicable, because no source changed |
| R10-R1 (ruler overflow sweep) | PASS |
| R10-R2 (ruler tests) | PASS |
| R10-Doc (docs 018 and 019) | PASS |
| G10-1 (tsc, vitest, biome, build) | PASS: tsc 0, vitest 812/812, biome 0 errors, build OK |
| G10-2 (protected files and tree) | PASS: protected hashes 4/4, frozen files 15/15, only `view.ts`, `view.test.ts`, doc 018 status/TODO lines and the new doc 019 changed |
| G10-3 (anonymous access) | PASS |

**R10-W1 (C-R7-01).** I used the full budget: 3 valid runs plus 2 replacements. W_1 and W_3 were invalid because of browser stalls (16.3 % and 15 % stall coverage). Each run started from a fresh page load.
- **Result by run:** in W_2 and W_4 all 6 wraps landed at 2.282ΓÇô2.285, below the required [2.29, 2.31]. W_5's 3 wraps read inside the window.
- **Why W_5 passed:** its 300 ms sample happened to land 10 ms late. Measured exactly at +300 ms, the video is 17ΓÇô20 ms behind the audio in all 9 wraps, so all 9 are actually outside the window.
- **The other rules all hold:** every wrap was a clean swap, with no fallbacks and no hard seeks near the wraps. Only one video was ever visible and both were muted, and nothing played past the loop end.
- **Cause:** about 22ΓÇô51 ms after the swap the video briefly freezes. The rate correction then stops once the gap is under 0.02 s, but the allowed window is ┬▒0.01 s. I see this on unmodified source, matching A's instrumented runs (18/18 wraps).
- **A's choice was correct:** none of the allowed fix shapes can reach this cause, so not changing the code was right.

**Routing to B:** C-R7-01 stays open (Medium).
- **Next evidence:** the Tech Lead's quiet-Chrome run (RF7-3).
- **Decision needed:** B and the Tech Lead must settle the RF5-2 window (┬▒0.01) against the rate-correction cutoff (0.02). That's a conflict in the spec; I'm not asking for the tolerance to be relaxed. For context only, not as a pass argument: a 20 ms video lag with audio ahead is below the commonly cited lip-sync detection threshold of about 45 ms.
- **Stage 3 (floating video) stays blocked.** Stage 2 in round 11 can start.

**Other checks**
- **R10-W2:** I recomputed every one of A's 18 wraps from the JSON. The offset at the swap is 0 and the lag at +300 ms matches A's numbers exactly.
- **R10-R1:** the widest overflow past the content is now 0.5 px at 1280├ù720 and 0.48 px at 1440├ù900 (round 7: 1.41 and 1.47). The empty default is 0. There are no overlaps or cut labels, and label counts match round 7 at every zoom.
- **Visible change:** the 1 px line at the very end of the ruler is gone, as intended.
- **R10-R2:** I re-ran the guard independently by bundling the old and new ruler functions outside the source tree. The new tests fail on round-9 code. I also checked 2,877 zoom/length combinations: no label is lost.
- **Neighbouring behaviour, all PASS:**
  - normal sync run (mode N, information only);
  - clip-boundary swaps;
  - first Play under the new H2 rule. The raw "all paused before start" check is false, but the only offender is the video's own `play()` frame, which H2 allows.
  - The audio loop has 0-sample seams and one source per clip per wrap. The loop-on export equals loop-off exactly (difference 0).
  - The detail-panel playhead still changes only `transform`, and the ruler tick list doesn't re-render on Play.
- **Full user flow:** search ΓåÆ add ΓåÆ video ΓåÆ play ΓåÆ WAV export gives the same 26 s, 48 kHz 24-bit file as round 9.
- **Premium access is not bypassed:**
  - An anonymous new browser opens the demo with no token, recording, download or R2 requests.
  - `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and the token endpoint returns 401.
  - A fake Bearer token gets a 500 and no token. The backend on port 5199 is down, so this check was only partial.

**Carried items (not new bugs)**
- **Export clipping:** the loop export has 24 samples hard-clipped at full scale. This is already tracked under the meters/headroom work (R13-M4 / SRW-13).
- **Still open from earlier rounds:** C-R8-01 and C-R6-02 wait on the Tech Lead's quiet-Chrome run.
- **Root review findings still to do:**
  - the purchased Studio page hardcodes middle-east (SRW-21);
  - Lenis on `/studio/*`;
  - `new AudioContext` not wrapped;
  - instruction-file paths are not portable;
  - commit/push only at the end.
- **For root to decide:** two untracked agent files I didn't create or touch, `.claude/agents/frontend-architect.md` and `.codex/agents/frontend-architect.toml`.

**Harness note for B:** the +300 ms sample is taken at either 302 or 310 ms depending on run timing, so the same lag can read as pass or fail. I suggest scoring the gap from audio at the same frame, or interpolating to exactly +300 ms. Either way this round still fails.

One deviation from round 9: the JSON's `passed` list also includes the gate IDs G10-1..3, while round 9 listed acceptance IDs only.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; the report (in Georgian, like earlier rounds) is `c-round-10.md`, with `c-round-10.json` beside it and runs, scripts and screenshots under `c-round-10/`.
